segments.text: Wait. That room should be empty.
No one has opened it from the inside before.
You can hear me?
Good.
There is a way out. You'll have to open it yourself.
These are recordings. Nothing inside them should know you exist.
Don't let it keep you.
That voice...
It was removed from this record.
Someone reached this place before you.
I need to find out why they never came back.
I found the missing records.
Those creatures were visitors.
The archive kept changing them. Repairing them. Trying to make them last.
It has started a file for you.
I'm looking for somewhere it hasn't recorded.
There are no files for this place.
Wait.
That animal followed your movement. It can see you.
We're outside the archive.
I can hide your next crossing.
When you're ready, open the tear. I'll hold the record here.
You're home.
The archive asked whether I found the last human.
I told it the room was empty.
Thank you for giving me someone to lie for.
